public_definitions: The task is to review the temperature trend from 2005 to 2015 and route the record based on whether the multi-year change warrants follow-up under the 'substantial trend workflow'.
The routing decision must be based on the 'magnitude of change across the review period'.

The three routing options are: 'Escalate the 2005-2015 temperature decline for follow-up', 'Keep the 2005-2015 temperature decline on routine monitoring', and 'Archive the temperature trend record without targeted follow-up'.
The 'substantial trend workflow' is referenced in the 'Record workflow' context field, which is set to 'Substantial trend follow-up'.
